form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Born-digital typed fillable form; every figure is typed. Office field reads 'Utah County Clerk' (index.csv 'County Clerk' - agrees). Street address, phone number and the signature block are redacted upstream by the county (black bars); the printed city 'Lindon, UT 84042' and the email survive. Amounts are typed WITHOUT dollar signs; comma thousands separators preserved. NOTE for readers: this filer, Aaron Davidson, is the sitting Utah County Clerk whose name also appears in the form's own letterhead ('Aaron Davidson, Clerk') - the letterhead is preprinted on every filing in this corpus and is NOT evidence about the filer; here the Name of Candidate field independently reads 'Aaron Davidson'. This cover page prints the filing address as 'disclosures@utahcounty.gov' where other v. 12.23 copies print 'elections@utahcounty.gov'.
